K-Shell Hybrid Method

Source: R/centrality-batch66.R
centrality_ksh.Rd

The k-shell hybrid method (ksh; Namtirtha et al. 2018) adds up, over the nodes within a few steps of a node, the root of the two nodes' summed k-shell indices and a share of the other node's degree, each divided by the squared distance: $$ksh(m) = \sum_{n:\,1 \le d_{mn} \le r} \frac{\sqrt{ks_m + ks_n} + \mu\,k_n}{d_{mn}^2},$$ with \(ks\) the k-shell index, \(k\) the degree, \(d_{mn}\) the distance and \(r\) the radius.

Usage

centrality_ksh(x, ...)

Arguments

x

Network input accepted by centrality.

...

Further arguments to centrality. The measure uses ksh_mu (the weight of the neighbor's degree, default 0.4) and ksh_radius (the largest distance summed over, default 3).

Value

A named numeric vector with one score per node, in input node order.

Details

The measure is computed on the simple undirected skeleton of the network, so direction, weights, loops and parallel edges are ignored. ksh_mu is 0.4 by default, the value of the source's worked example and of two of its tables. The authors tune it per network (0.4, 0.1 and 0.01 in the source) and recommend no single value; it must lie in \([0, 1]\). ksh_radius is 3 by default, the value the source recommends; Inf sums over the whole component. The root covers the shell sum alone and the distance is squared: with these defaults the implementation reproduces the 13 values and the worked value the source prints for its 13-node example (truncated to two decimals) and the 13 values Maji et al. (2020) print for the same network, on the edge list read from the figures of both papers. Isolated nodes score 0. A ksh_mu outside \([0, 1]\), or a ksh_radius that is not a whole number of at least one or Inf, raises a cograph_bad_parameter error. normalized = TRUE divides the scores by their maximum.

References

Namtirtha, A., Dutta, A. and Dutta, B. (2018). Identifying influential spreaders in complex networks based on kshell hybrid method. Physica A: Statistical Mechanics and its Applications, 499, 310-324. doi:10.1016/j.physa.2018.02.016 .

Maji, G., Namtirtha, A., Dutta, A. and Curado Malta, M. (2020). Influential spreaders identification in complex networks with improved k-shell hybrid method. Expert Systems with Applications, 144, 113092. doi:10.1016/j.eswa.2019.113092 .

See also

centrality_eskh, centrality_ikh, centrality_coreness, centrality_gravity, centrality.

Examples

centrality_ksh(regulation_net)
#>    Explore       Plan    Monitor      Adapt    Reflect    Discuss Synthesize 
#>   29.97056   33.49188   37.01320   33.19188   29.67056   30.27056   27.04924 
#>   Evaluate     Create      Share 
#>   30.87056   33.79188   30.87056 
centrality_ksh(regulation_net, ksh_mu = 0.1)
#>    Explore       Plan    Monitor      Adapt    Reflect    Discuss Synthesize 
#>   20.22056   22.69188   25.16320   22.61688   20.14556   20.29556   17.89924 
#>   Evaluate     Create      Share 
#>   20.44556   22.76688   20.44556
